name: The Golden Rat
desc:
The Golden Rat is home to [The Golden Rats](faction:the_golden_rats) and [Dravik, The Rat King](entity:dravik_the_rat_king), with the location being a Tavern inside of a cave. [Golden Warriors](entity:golden_warrior) can be found at every corner with some even drinking Tankards of Plumfruit Juice.

Outside, the [Golden Bouncer](entity:golden_rat_bouncer) will tell you to enter.
